title: Online 3D Studio
label: START HERE
bullets: GEN3D Studio Live 0.11.0
Text or image → 3D mesh
Kaggle runs the AI; your PC runs GEN3D
narration: Welcome to Gen three D Studio Live. This guide shows how to set up online three D generation using your own Kaggle GPU session. The app screens are real. The preview model is an illustrative sample, not proof of a successful live Hunyuan generation.

title: Download both files
label: 01 · GITHUB
bullets: Windows installer: version 0.11.0
Notebook: GEN3D-Kaggle.ipynb
Install GEN3D on your Windows PC
narration: Open the version zero point eleven release on GitHub. Download the Windows installer and the Kaggle notebook. Run the installer on your PC. If you choose the zip instead, extract it first. This is an unsigned development preview.

title: Prepare Kaggle
label: 02 · KAGGLE
bullets: Create a notebook and import the .ipynb
Enable a CUDA GPU accelerator
Enable Internet access
narration: In your Kaggle account, create a notebook and import the downloaded notebook file. Select a CUDA GPU accelerator, and enable Internet. GPU access may require account verification. Availability, quotas, and session time limits are controlled by Kaggle. Free GPU access is not permanent hosting.

title: Keep your token private
label: 03 · KAGGLE SECRETS
bullets: Secret name: GEN3D_GPU_TOKEN
Use a unique random value: 32–512 characters
Enable access for this notebook
Keep the same value for the desktop app
narration: Open Kaggle's Secrets interface, usually under Add ons. Create the secret named on screen, using a unique random value of at least thirty two characters. Enable it for this notebook. Keep the same value securely for the desktop app. Never paste it into a public notebook cell or GitHub.

title: Run the notebook
label: 04 · START THE GPU SERVICE
bullets: Run setup and enter your provider name
Run the server cell; leave it running
Copy the printed HTTPS connection URL
First use downloads several GB of weights
narration: Run the setup cell and enter the full legal name of the person or organization operating your GPU service. Then run the server cell and leave it running. Setup checks CUDA and dependencies. Copy the H T T P S connection URL it prints. The first generation downloads model weights and may take several minutes.

title: Connect GEN3D
label: 05 · DESKTOP APP
bullets: Projection Studio → Online 3D Studio
Paste your notebook's HTTPS URL
Enter the same token → Connect GPU
The token field clears after submission
narration: In Gen three D, open Projection Studio and expand Online three D Studio, Hunyuan three D. Paste the connection URL printed by your own running notebook. Enter the same private token and choose Connect GPU. The token field clears after submission. Do not use somebody else's URL or token.

title: Create from text
label: 06 · TEXT → 3D
bullets: Choose Text description
Describe one complete, isolated object
Start with 30 steps and seed 0
Select Generate 3D model
narration: For text, choose Text description. Describe one complete object, such as a friendly orange robot on a plain background. Start with thirty shape steps and seed zero, then choose Generate three D model. The backend first creates a reference image with S D X L Turbo, then builds a Hunyuan mesh.

title: Create from an image
label: 07 · IMAGE → 3D
bullets: Choose Reference image
Select a PNG or JPEG of one subject
Maximum: 10 MB and 16 megapixels
Then choose Generate 3D model
narration: For image input, choose Reference image, then choose a P N G or J peg file. Use one clearly visible subject with as little background clutter as possible. The file limit is ten megabytes and sixteen megapixels. Choose Generate three D model after selecting your image. Wait for the GPU job to finish.

title: Review before going live
label: 08 · MODEL PREVIEW
bullets: Completed downloads enter your local library
Inspect the model in the preview
Preview does not change live projection
Shown here: a procedural sample, not AI output
narration: When a job succeeds, the model downloads into your local library. Review it in the preview before using it. This video uses a procedural sample robot to explain the controls. It is not Hunyuan output. Generating and previewing a model do not change your live projection.

title: Save or use the model
label: 09 · EXPLICIT LIVE CONTROL
bullets: Save GLB copy → choose a folder
Use reviewed model on projection → goes live
Generated meshes are not automatically rigged
No automatic mouth animation or singing
narration: Choose Save G L B copy to export the model to a folder. Choose Use reviewed model on projection only when you are ready to show it. That explicit action changes projection. The sample on screen demonstrates this control. Generated meshes are not automatically rigged, animated, or able to sing.

title: Cancel and reconnect
label: 10 · SESSION CONTROL
bullets: Cancel requests disposal of the current job
A running GPU operation may finish first
Restarted notebook? Reconnect with its new URL
Downloaded models remain on your PC
narration: Use Cancel if you no longer need a job. A GPU operation already running may finish before cancellation can discard its result. If Kaggle stops or restarts, run the notebook again and reconnect using its new URL. Models already downloaded remain on your PC and can be reviewed offline.

title: What is verified?
label: LIMITS & TROUBLESHOOTING
bullets: Connection failure: check URL, token and server cell
Job failure: inspect gen3d-gpu.log in Kaggle
Current output: untextured, unrigged GLB meshes
Actual inference on Kaggle remains unverified
narration: If connection fails, check the URL, token, Internet access, and running server cell. If generation fails, inspect the G P U log in Kaggle. This profile creates untextured, unrigged meshes. Automated app and service tests passed, but actual inference on Kaggle hardware remains unverified. Use the linked setup guide for details.
